author: Yulia
text:
This trip was my first experience of a holiday on a yacht. I was very worried that I might not like it or that it would be uncomfortable. But the trip turned out to be amazing. Huge thanks to Sofa for organising it.
I was able to rest and recharge in this short period of time.
I'll gladly do the trip again when I get the chance.
